check.name: EmptyLineWrappingInBlock
check.description:
Checks the empty line right after the opening brace and right before the closing brace of a block.

topSeparator controls the line after the opening brace and bottomSeparator controls the line before the closing brace. Both accept the following values:

  • empty_line - exactly one empty line is required;
  • empty_line_allowed - not validated, an empty line may be present or absent;
  • no_empty_line - an empty line is forbidden.

property.name: bottomSeparator
property.description: Specify the policy for the empty line before the closing brace.

property.name: topSeparator
property.description: Specify the policy for the empty line after the opening brace.
